governing_constraints: Dedicated private Standard distribution OSS bucket; do not reuse backup/test buckets or docs CDN.
Plan actual bucket name/region, packages CDN scope, origin host/TLS, certificate and CNAME before mutations.
Keep preview canonical bytes and /repo default; verify same Host/TLS and signed clients before DNS cutover.
Uploader limited Put/Get prefixes; origin read-only dedicated bucket; activator only packages CDN. No Delete, broad RAM, DNS/cert authority in routine roles.
First design relies on forbid-overwrite and thus does not enable or suspend versioning.
No multi-object or global CDN atomicity claim.
Historical offline/hardware custody/key-missing text is superseded by the dependency matrix; no private key access needed for this inventory.
